name: layout_page_contents
description: What one page-controlled area shows on one page: a media item, a view page or a group of the view.
lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save; deleted with its page or area.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the layout (tenant key).
Media item a media area shows on the page; it cannot be deleted while named.
columns.Null meaning: The area is a catalog area.

columns.Meaning: View page, from 1, a catalog area shows on the page.
columns.Null meaning: The content is a media item or a group.

columns.Meaning: Selection choice whose group a catalog area shows on the page.
columns.Null meaning: The content is a media item or a view page.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, area_id) REFERENCES layout_areas(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The area belongs to the same company; contents are deleted with it.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, media_asset_id) REFERENCES media_assets(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The media item belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while named.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, page_id) REFERENCES layout_pages(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The page belongs to the same company; contents are deleted with it.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((num_nonnulls(media_asset_id, view_page, group_choice_id) = 1) AND ((view_page IS NULL) OR ((view_page >= 1) AND (view_page <= 1000)))))
constraints.Purpose: Each content names exactly one media item, view page or group, with view pages from 1.
One content per page and area.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX layout_page_contents_area_idx ON public.layout_page_contents USING btree (company_id, area_id)
CREATE INDEX layout_page_contents_media_idx ON public.layout_page_contents USING btree (company_id, media_asset_id)
